title: Template-aware drift message
goal: Inside the template, unreleased copies are named as waiting for the next release
acceptance: A committed test fails first, unchanged by the fix
Inside the template: one line naming the unreleased copies, no project advice
In a project: the drift message is unchanged
privacy: Tool and rule text only; fixtures invented.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the audit: one condition and a test. Not a measurement.
